description: Cattle supply chain infrastructure in Colombia is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors CLARE SULLIVAN, Clare Sullivan. This spatial dataset contains point data (latitude and longitude) for key infrastructure in the cattle supply chain (slaughterhouses, meatpackers, and dairies), allowing for mapping of the supply chain and analysis of geographic patterns related to the cattle sector. Coverage: national (CO); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. Formats: ZIP. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC0 1.0. Caveats: written from the Dataverse search and dataset metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
